original.scope: DE market/package corroboration only; retailer, not scientific authority

paraphrase: Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil is the declared INCI; supplier describes pressing coconut white flesh before refining.

original.scope: Primary paper abstract: Ruetsch, Kamath, Rele, Mohile; J Cosmet Sci 52(3):169-184 (2001)
paraphrase: Cross-sectional TOF-SIMS located coconut-oil characteristic ions inside treated human hair; mineral oil contrasted in the tested conditions.
limitations: Ex-vivo fibre evidence, not an exact Biopark product experiment or ordinary-dose performance guarantee. Abstract does not resolve every processing grade/contact-time condition. Commercial Marico coauthors; not an independent consumer efficacy trial.
